summary: Integrated ecosystem replay and hashes into release provenance and promotion gates.
acceptance_evidence: build-release.ps1 runs ecosystem replay by default and records it in gates.
Provenance records registry snapshot, lockfile, staged set, active set and replay hashes.
Promotion status is promotable with zero blockers after all gates pass.

commands.summary: Release gates passed, including ecosystem replay, image build, service recovery smoke and QEMU runtime smoke.
Replay result remained consumable by release provenance.
Alpha rootfs validation passed with ecosystem artifacts included.

blocked_shortcuts: Release cannot treat a stale replay file as sufficient when the default gate is run.
Skipping ecosystem replay becomes an explicit promotion blocker.
Provenance distinguishes staged and active artifact projections.
promotion_impact: Production Candidate provenance now binds ecosystem inputs and replay results as first-class release gates.
